plan.summary: Fix AI Destek panel UX: after user approves a plan, auto-apply the generated flowconfig to canvas instead of requiring manual 'Uygula' click. Also strengthen system prompt to ensure Claude generates flowconfig in the same response as approval.
plan.q_intent: planı açıklayıp daha sonra onay alması, onaylanırsa hemen flowu güncellemesi lazım. bilgiyi verip bekliyor
plan.interview_notes: Q confirmed this is in the AiChatPanel (flow editor AI Destek section), not the standalone WizardPage.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When AI generates a flowconfig in edit mode (AiChatPanel), it auto-applies to the canvas without requiring manual 'Uygula' button click
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: autoApplyPending flag in ai-chat-store triggers useEffect in AiChatPanel that calls onApply

acceptance_criteria.criterion: System prompt instructs Claude to generate flowconfig in the same response after user approval (evet, tamam, devam et, etc.)
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Updated both edit mode rules and general rules in BuildSystemPrompt

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Manual Uygula/Reddet banner still works as fallback if auto-apply doesn't trigger
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: pendingFlowConfig banner remains in AiChatPanel JSX, only hidden when autoApplyPending clears it

files_changed.change: Strengthened edit mode and general rules in system prompt to generate flowconfig in same response after user approval
Added autoApplyPending flag and clearAutoApply action; set flag on new flowconfig arrival
Added useEffect for auto-apply: when autoApplyPending && pendingFlowConfig, auto-call onApply

verification_questions.question: Does the auto-apply effect correctly clear the autoApplyPending flag to prevent infinite re-renders?
Is the pendingFlowConfig properly consumed (set to null) after auto-apply, so the Uygula banner disappears?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: If auto-apply fails, the existing Uygula/Reddet banner remains as fallback. No data loss possible.

aha_moments.user_pain: User approves AI plan but nothing happens — has to manually click Uygula to apply changes
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-apply flowconfig to canvas immediately after AI generates it following user approval
aha_moments.aha_moment: User clicks 'Evet, bu planla devam et' and instantly sees the flow update on the canvas

aha_moments.user_pain: Extra click required to apply AI-generated flow changes slows down the design iteration cycle
aha_moments.suggestion: Eliminate the manual Uygula step for a seamless plan-approve-apply flow
aha_moments.aha_moment: User realizes AI assistance is truly hands-free — approve and done

aha_moments.user_pain: AI sometimes explains the plan but doesn't generate flowconfig JSON, leaving user stuck
aha_moments.suggestion: Strengthen system prompt to always generate flowconfig in same response as approval
aha_moments.aha_moment: Every approval click results in actual flow changes — no more 'information only' dead ends

aha_moments.user_pain: Manual Uygula/Reddet banner is confusing for non-technical users who already gave approval
aha_moments.suggestion: Keep banner as fallback but default to auto-apply for smoother UX
aha_moments.aha_moment: User sees changes applied automatically but still has undo capability via the flow editor

aha_moments.user_pain: Support tickets about AI Destek not applying changes after approval
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-apply reduces confusion and support overhead for flow wizard usage
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support team notices fewer 'AI not working' complaints after the fix
